chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 335: The Chief Recorder Summons Li Huowang for a Zuowandao Hunt
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang is summoned to the Yinling Grand Prison for a secret mission against the Zuowandao. The arrival of the eunuch Chief Recorder signals a shift into the deadly politics of the Supervisory Heavenly Office.
og_title: A New Boss Appears in the Dao-Twisted World
og_description: The Chief Recorder, a fat eunuch with a gold abacus, arrives in Yinling City to lead a hunt for the Zuowandao—and he's got his eye on Li Huowang.
twitter_title: The Office calls a meeting. Bring your own body horror.
twitter_description: Li Huowang is recruited for a mysterious mission against the Zuowandao, overseen by a terrifyingly polite eunuch official with a gold abacus.

lore_anchors.definition: A high-ranking eunuch official within the Supervisory Heavenly Office, likely connected to imperial court politics. He is Li Huowang’s superior’s superior, wielding significant power and a deceptively friendly demeanor.
A malformed, blind creature born from a person who lives past 120 without achieving immortality and forcibly extends their life with elixirs. They are a benchmark of power in this world.
The government-sponsored supernatural law enforcement body. Its internal culture is a mix of brutal pragmatism, dark fraternity, and generous employee benefits (including brothel fees).
A classification rank, likely part of a hierarchical system used by the Office to grade prisoners, monsters, or Renxiao by threat level.
